scope: Development only. The four objects below are not independent validation data.

candidate.name: Source-conditioned Lab chroma anchoring
candidate.estimate: Compute the componentwise median Lab a*/b* difference between the transformed source condition RGB and generated unique6 tile 0. Estimate on alpha >= 0.75 after a 3-pixel binary erosion; require at least 64 pixels in each trusted region.
candidate.bound: Clip each estimated a*/b* offset independently to [-6,+6] Lab units.
candidate.application: Apply the same bounded offset to all six GFL output views, weighted by their antialiased silhouette masks. Preserve zero-mask RGB pixels exactly. Save to a new candidate path; never overwrite source predictions.
candidate.registration: No source-to-target pixel correspondence is assumed. The estimate is a robust distribution anchor between source view and generated source view.
allowed_inputs: six target silhouette masks from the geometry/alpha path
forbidden_inputs: GT RGB/color statistics for parameter estimation
GT UV or hidden target texture
copying source pixels into unseen views

evaluation.unit: object; average the five non-source views equally within each object
evaluation.GT_use: GT RGB is opened only after correction parameters and candidate RGB are fixed; it is used for metrics and casebook panels only.
evaluation.visual_review: Record each failure-enriched case, plus the normal and high-texture case; inspect colors, fine detail, structure, boundary halos and unseen-view consistency.

advance_to_independent_validation_only_i: At least 3/4 objects have a lower five-view mean FG-CIEDE2000.
The four-object mean five-view FG-CIEDE2000 change is <= -1.0.
Mean five-view FG-PSNR change is > -0.50 dB and mean FG-LPIPS change is < +0.010.
Mean foreground L* SSIM change is > -0.010.
Both failure-enriched objects visibly improve without a new cast, and neither the normal nor high-texture object shows obvious detail or structure damage.
development_gate.stop: If any gate fails, report the negative result and do not run the Fresh B candidate. No parameter, mask, or threshold changes are permitted after this lock.

holdout_separation.rule: Do not open Fresh B prediction pixels or Fresh B repair metrics until the development gate passes and a final validation amendment records this lock hash, candidate code hash, and all validation endpoints.
